newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha steady, but keeps wary eye on crude.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha steady, but keeps wary eye on crude.

text.p: NWE naphtha prices were stable on Friday amid lacklustre demand and stable crude.
The market was carefully tracking crude which has been hit by sharp drops recently.
Traders said full range was pegged around $187 cif NWE with light virgin $2 or so stronger and N+A about $2-3 lower.
A refiner was understood to have sold 6,000 tonnes of 72 paraffinic material into the barge market on a floating basis on Thursday.
